answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after verified work, like water slowly carving a river through a mesa: cheap to start, expensive to fake at scale. A sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back; the tundra of idle identities freezes out because unproductive accounts never recoup the lockup. Attack cost grows linearly with each fake identity, while the defender verification cost stays flat.
